name: Teldrassil
label: Quest
description: Following the cleansing of the rogue harpies near the Oracle Tree, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak entrusts you with carrying a status report to Darnassus.…
intro: Following the cleansing of the rogue harpies near the Oracle Tree, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak entrusts you with carrying a status report to Darnassus. The inscribed bark is addressed to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, bearing news of the state of the boughs and the ongoing corruption plaguing the World Tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The forest whispers of your feats of valor, friend. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.
Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, druid. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.
I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.
Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
